title: Have a Look & Have a Rest
partTitle: Have a Look & Have a Rest
situation: Checking a machine and taking a short break after a busy morning.
objective: Use have a look and have a rest to offer help and talk about a break.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: When the conveyor stops, my supervisor says, "Can you have a look?"
dialogue.indonesian: Ketika konveyor berhenti, supervisor saya berkata, "Bisa kamu cek?"

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: I have a look at the sensor and the cable first.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya memeriksa sensor dan kabel terlebih dahulu.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: After I finish the repair, I usually have a short rest and drink some water.
dialogue.indonesian: Setelah selesai memperbaiki, saya biasanya istirahat sebentar dan minum air.

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: My teammate says, "You can have a rest. I will check the machine."
dialogue.indonesian: Rekan kerja saya berkata, "Kamu bisa istirahat. Saya akan memeriksa mesinnya."

dialogue.speaker: Narrator
dialogue.english: If we have a rest, we can start the next shift with more energy.
dialogue.indonesian: Jika kami sempat istirahat, kami bisa memulai shift berikutnya dengan lebih segar.

keyExpressions.english: have a look at the machine

learningNotes: have a look memakai a karena look di sini berarti satu kali melihat.
Setelah have a look, gunakan at untuk menyebut bendanya: have a look at the sensor.
have a rest sama artinya dengan take a break, dan keduanya sama-sama benar.
